facts.rationale: Clears cmd_vars[1], then selects ftCh_Init_801560D8 when x2258 equals 0x185, otherwise ftCh_Init_80156018. The helpers enter motion 0x156 or ftMh_MS_Wait1_0 respectively, with position and animation-frame handling. This is phase-dependent wait entry, not invariant Wait1_0 entry. Equivalent dispatch appears in doAnim1, called by the wait animation callback. The name is descriptive; the exact original identifier and full meaning of the numeric phase markers remain uncertain.
